rows.name: MMMU-Pro (Overall)
rows.focus: Robust version of MMMU that adds a vision-only input setting and increases candidate options from 4 to 10.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: MMMU-Pro Overall — accuracy 0-100 (no unit printed); 74 of 213 rows have it · https://mmmu-benchmark.github.io/leaderboard_data.json
Effort [page]: Name — settings as separate rows via the model name (e.g. 'w/ tools' vs 'w/o tools', 'Thinking (High)') · https://mmmu-benchmark.github.io/leaderboard_data.json
Date [page]: Date — date per entry (YYYY-MM-DD) · https://mmmu-benchmark.github.io/leaderboard_data.json
Other [page]: Size / row type — parameter count; rows colour-coded hum
rows.notes: JS-rendered table; values from https://mmmu-benchmark.github.io/leaderboard_data.json (loaded by static/js/index.js). Human Expert rows excluded from top-3. Page says 'Last updated: 09/05/2025' though JSON contains later entries. No per-sub anchor; click 'MMMU-Pro' header to expand.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L3 (Advanced); bootstrap agreement: L3 93%, L2 6%.
Placed from 58 models' published scores; guessing floor 13% removed.
Best observed: GPT-6.1 Terra 85.5, Kimi K3.1 Pro 84.1, Gemini 3.1 Pro 83.9.

Other
rows.notes: Official README results table reports only per-context-length totals over all 13 tasks, not per category; no per-category leaderboard (per-task results only in paper arXiv:2404.06654).

rows.name: OpenAI-MRCR 2-needle
rows.focus: Long multi-turn conversation hides 2 identical asks; model must return the i-th instance of one of them (multi-round co-reference resolution).
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: OpenAI-MRCR: 2 needle 128k / OpenAI-MRCR: 2 needle 1M — accuracy % (SequenceMatcher ratio) in the GPT-4.1 post's long-context appendix table; 128k for 8 OpenAI models, 1M only for the 3 GPT-4.1 models · https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-1/
Breakdown [page]: accuracy vs input length — '2 needle' tab of the 'OpenAI MRCR accuracy' chart (values not readable as text) · https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-1/
Effort [page]: OpenAI o1 (high), OpenAI o3-mini (high) — effort only in the model col
rows.notes: No official leaderboard; dataset card says 'See OpenAI's blog post (https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-1/) for full results'. 100 samples per token bin, bins 4K-1M tokens; metric = SequenceMatcher ratio. Inspired by Gemini's MRCR from the Michelangelo paper (arXiv:2409.12640).
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: No official per-model score for the 2-needle split as a whole: no leaderboard; the dataset card points to the GPT-4.1 blog, which reports per context bin (and mostly as charts). The only numeric official values for 2-needle are per-bin: GPT-4.1 blog table "OpenAI-MRCR: 2 needle 128k" - GPT-4.1 57.2, GPT-4.1 mini 47.2, GPT-4.1 nano 36.6, GPT-4o (2024-11-20) 31.9, GPT-4o mini 24.5, OpenAI o1 (high) 22.1, OpenAI o3-mini (high) 18.7, GPT-4.5 38.5; "2 needle 1M" - GPT-4.1 46.3, mi
